(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimensions D5 and D6 have tolerance bands of 0.05 mm on a part that is zinc plated, but the drawing does not state whether the tolerances include or exclude the plating thickness. This matters because plating buildup can push the finished diameters out of tolerance and prevent assembly. The designer should add a note clarifying that the stated limits apply after plating, or adjust the pre-plate dimensions to allow for the coating thickness."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note specifying that dimensions D5 and D6 are after plating, or reduce the nominal sizes by twice the plating thickness so the final coated parts remain within the -0.05/-0.1 tolerance band."}]}
